newsitem.title: USA: AGCO files for stock offering.
newsitem.headline: AGCO files for stock offering.

text.p: AGCO Corp, a maker and distributor of agricultural equipment, Wednesday said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 4.7 million shares of common stock.

AGCO will offer 4,500,000 shares and 200,000 will be offered by a selling stockholder. The company intends to grant the underwriters of the offering an overallotment option to acquire an additional 675,000 shares.
Merrill Lynch & Co, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc will co-manage the proposed offering.

The company will use the net proceeds from the proposed sale of the shares to reduce outstanding indebtedness under its revolving credit facility. The company will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale of the shares by the selling stockholder.
